title: Background Jobs
description: Celery worker + beat health across all scheduled and dispatched tasks, using auto-instrumented Celery spans (no custom sacco_ metric backs this dashboard).

panels.title: Task run rate by task name
panels.query: Count of Celery task spans (emitted by logfire.instrument_celery()) bucketed per minute, grouped by the task-name span attribute.
panels.notes: Backed entirely by Celery span instrumentation, not a custom metric.

panels.title: Task success/failure rate by task name
panels.query: Count of Celery task spans grouped by task-name and outcome (span status ok vs error/exception recorded), bucketed per minute.

panels.title: Task duration p95 by task name
panels.query: approx_percentile_cont(duration, 0.95) over Celery task span durations, bucketed per 5 minutes, grouped by task-name span attribute.

panels.title: Recent task failures
panels.query: Most recent Celery task spans with an error/exception status, showing task name, exception message, and timestamp, for drilling into individual failures.
